dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: So you already know about the fact that Stanley was actually my friend. You must have heard the truth at the bottom of my bottle, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: ...I do remember that I did meet you — and someone else to boot — while drunk one day...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Hmm, I can't quite remember why, but I've felt much more relaxed ever since then.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I only call myself Stanley today in order to ensure that his tales will remain on everyone's lips.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Haha, I imagine that if this were me from before, being exposed like this would have frustrated me for sure...
